query_text: Mala intends to visit her son in Australia. Mala gave a Special Power of Attorney to her daughter Visaka in 2017 to sell her house in Colombo. Mala also intends to lease the house to Sheela. Can Visaka execute the lease agreement with Sheela on behalf of Mala if Mala travels to Australia? Advise Mala on how to execute the lease agreement in her absence.
